title: Okay I am SO ready to see Boop now- Jasmine is a STAR 🤩#JimmyAwards #...
transcript: All I have to do. How much I love you. All I have to do is put my love into one side. Another changing situation. Passion would have cooled another. Magic would have died. It's easy. All I have to do is pretend I never knew him. Try to barely find it. All I ever wanted. Love you. And now I see the face. Have a life.
